offers_products.reason: Sells lab instruments, reagents, consumables, diagnostics and lab equipment as its core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Offers CDMO and PPD CRO services, instrument repair, lab management and training.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, labs, hospitals, universities and industry; not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to pharma and biotech companies, academic institutions, clinical labs, hospitals, and government agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely repeat orders of consumables, reagents and supplies, plus service contracts and ongoing CDMO/CRO programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Pharma, biotech, diagnostics and clinical research demand is steady; consumables and drug manufacturing are needed through downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Most sales are consumables, reagents, supplies and recurring services; instruments are big but a smaller share.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue mainly comes from manufactured instruments, consumables and facility-based manufacturing, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large pharma, biotech, hospitals, universities, governments and industrial companies.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many manufacturing plants, CDMO drug-making facilities and labs worldwide needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Segments: Life Sciences Solutions, Analytical Instruments, Specialty Diagnostics, Laboratory Products and Biopharma Services; products judged larger than services.
